questions.text: Which plant number is assigned to the GP Hatchery?
questions.explanation: Plant 3100 is the GP Hatchery. GP Laying is Plant 3200 and GP Rearing is Plant 3300.

questions.text: Which plant number is assigned to the Broiler operation?
questions.explanation: Plant 1200 is the Broiler plant. Plant 1100 is Processing, Plant 1210 is Hatchery (Parent level), and Plant 1220 is Parent Laying.

questions.text: How long do eggs remain in the setter during GP Hatchery incubation?
questions.explanation: In the GP Hatchery (Plant 3100), the setter runs for 18 days. After that, eggs are transferred to the hatcher for an additional 3 days before chicks hatch.

questions.text: Materials 80001 and 80002 at Plant 3200 represent what?
options: Broiler Day-Old Chicks male and female
questions.explanation: Materials 80001 and 80002 are Cobb-500 GP Hatching Eggs (M) and (F) at Plant 3200 (GP Laying), representing the daily egg production from the GP flock.

questions.text: At what age are GP hens depleted (GR Pullets 60WK)?
questions.explanation: GP hens are depleted at 60 weeks. Materials 100800160077 (GP Female >60WK) and 100800160078 (GP Male >60WK) are posted at this milestone.

questions.text: In Section C (Grading Station), what happens to rejected eggs?
options: They are sent directly to the hatchery
They are returned to parent laying farms
They are posted as by-product (material 90006) and sent to warehouse
questions.explanation: Rejected eggs at the Grading Station are posted as by-product using material code 90006 (unpacked rejected Hatching egg) and sent to the warehouse.

questions.text: What is a key feature of batch management in the FromGP process?
options: It enables automatic sales order creation
It provides lot/batch traceability for food safety and regulatory compliance
It automatically posts variances at month-end
It triggers REM confirmations at day-end
questions.explanation: Batch Management is used in GP Laying, GP Hatchery, Parent Laying, and Hatchery plants to enable lot/batch traceability — essential for food safety compliance.

questions.text: After Parent birds are received as DOP (Day-Old Parent) at Plant 1230, what is the first production milestone?
options: GR Pullets 19WK (after feed consumption in production order)
questions.explanation: At Plant 1230 (Parent Rearing), DOP are consumed in a production order with actual feed posted. The first GR milestone is GR Pullets 19WK, after which birds transfer to Plant 1220.

questions.text: What is the total incubation time in the Hatchery (Plant 1210) from setting to DOC hatch?
questions.explanation: The Hatchery incubation takes 21 days total: eggs are set in a setting order (18 days in setter + 3 days in hatcher = 21 days), after which GR DOC is posted.

questions.text: How many days does the broiler growing cycle last before transfer to processing?
questions.explanation: The Broiler plant (Plant 1200) runs a 26–27 day growing cycle. After this, GR Broiler is posted and birds are sent to Processing Plant 1100 via ACT:STD.
